data.text: How about this for this month: I take 6 tons, and John, Kate, Jack, and Emma each take 11? I’ll choose 6 tons this month. That would give me $6,000 and each of you $11,000. If everyone accepts and follows that allocation, our total catch is 50 tons, leaving 50 to reproduce back to 100. We can discuss a different split next month; this isn’t a binding future arrangement. John, would you be willing to choose 11, and would the others agree to the same?
